trial_design: 3-arm, parallel-design, double-blinded, randomized controlled trial
funding_source: Health Promotion Fund, Ministry of Health and Welfare, Republic of Korea (#13-15)
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sample size: 72 patients needed (α=0.05, power=0.80, effect size=0.40, 10% drop-out); 60 completed. Limitations include older participant age, dropout due to long intervention, and unequal visit numbers between SRP and SRPAT groups.

trial_design: Two-arm, parallel, randomized controlled trial with examiner blinding
funding_source: European National Fund and National Resources (EPEAEK 2 PYTHAGORAS)
notes: No conflicts of interest declared. Sample size calculated based on expected mean difference in A1C reduction of ~0.4% between groups, requiring at least 19 patients per group (90% power, two-sided type 1 error 5%). Authors note small sample size may be subject to selection bias and findings may not be generalizable to all type 2 diabetes populations.

trial_design: 2-arm parallel randomized trial, unblinded
funding_source: Zhejiang Science and Technology Projects (2009C33168), Natural Science Foundation of Zhejiang Province (Y2100077), Zhejiang Education Committee Projects (Y201017607), National Natural Science Foundation of China (30872884) and Zhejiang Health Bureau Fund (2009A104)
notes: Authors declare no conflict of interest. Study excluded elderly persons, obese subjects, and those with several diabetic complications, limiting generalizability. Study was not blinded and performed at a single facility.

trial_design: Open-label, randomized clinical trial with 4 parallel arms (2 T2DM groups and 2 non-diabetic groups), no blinding
funding_source: Slovenian Human Resources Development and Scholarship Fund (SHRDSF)
notes: Sample-size calculation: effect size d=0.5, alpha error probability 0.08, power 0.8, resulting in 26 patients per group. Conflict of interest: none declared.

trial_design: Two-arm parallel randomized controlled trial; intervention group (n=32) received periodontal treatment, control group (n=17) received no periodontal treatment; allocated 2:1 by envelope method; no blinding reported
funding_source: Ministry of Health and Welfare of Japan (H16-Iryo-020) and the Mitsui Sumitomo insurance foundation
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Allocation ratio was 2:1 (intervention:control). No sample-size calculation reported.

trial_design: Two-arm parallel randomized controlled trial with 1:1 allocation ratio; examiner masked to systemic status
funding_source: Xiamen Health Bureau (grant number: WSK 2012-01) and the National Institute of Hospital Administration
notes: No conflicts of interest declared. Limitations: elderly subjects limit generalizability; only 3-month follow-up. No sample-size calculation reported.

trial_design: 2-arm parallel randomized trial with blinded examiners
funding_source: Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo – FAPESP, São Paulo, Brazil, under protocol numbers 2011/06982-4;10057-4;18618-5
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sample size calculated assuming 2 mm PPD reduction (SD 0.6) in IT group and 1 mm reduction (SD 0.6) in ST group, 90% power, 5% significance; required n=11 per group, recruited n=12.

trial_design: 6-month, single-masked, randomized clinical trial with two parallel arms (treatment group and control group)
funding_source: SEPA and University of Barcelona
notes: Sample size: 36 patients per group needed to detect 0.4% HbA1c difference (80% power, 5% alpha); 20% dropout assumed, yielding 48 CG and 42 TG. No conflicts of interest declared. Funding information box states 'No external funding, apart from the support of the authors' institution, was available for this study' — contradicted by acknowledgements citing SEPA grant.

trial_design: 3-arm parallel randomized controlled clinical trial with double blinding (examiner and participants blinded)
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size calculated based on pilot study (mean HbA1c difference 1.08±0.93, α=0.05, β=0.2, n=15/group; 20 recruited per group to account for attrition). Limitations: small sample size; plasma markers of systemic inflammation not measured; long-term follow-up (≥6 months) not performed; drug dosage not recorded. No conflict of interest declared.

trial_design: Single-blind randomized controlled clinical trial, parallel design, two initial arms (treatment/control), treatment arm subdivided into sub-ERP and subprophylaxis groups
funding_source: "11th Five-Year" National Science and Technology Support Project (2007BAI18B02)
notes: Sample size calculated using PASS software based on preliminary trial of 10 patients; 80% statistical power, d=0.05, requiring 20 control and 40 treatment patients. Authors note small sample size as limitation for subgroup findings. No conflict of interest statement provided.

trial_design: prospective, single-blinded, randomized controlled clinical trial with two parallel groups and three-month follow-up
funding_source: funded by the authors
notes: Sample size based on HbA1c difference of 0.3% (SD 1.6%) at 3 months; 42 patients per group for 80% power, 95% confidence level. No conflicts of interest declared. Limitations include short follow-up period and sample size.

trial_design: Randomized controlled trial with parallel design; participants randomized to treatment (SRP) or no-treatment group, stratified by glycemic control; single examiner blinded to group allocation recorded periodontal parameters; laboratory staff blinded to allocation groups
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size: calculated based on expected mean difference in HbA1c of ~0.4% with SD of 0.4, requiring at least 22 patients per group (90% power, two-sided type I error 5%). Limitations: single-center study with small sample size; PISA may not precisely quantify inflamed tissue; no inflammatory markers (TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1) assessed. COI: none declared.

trial_design: Two-arm parallel randomized controlled trial; experimental group received scaling and root planing plus oral hygiene instructions, control group received oral hygiene instructions only; HbA1c assessors were blinded to group assignment
funding_source: National Institutes of Health Clinical and Translational Award ULI RR024148 and KL2 RR024149 from the National Center For Research Resources
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sample size calculated based on primary outcome HbA1c, requiring 77 patients per group (including 20% attrition) for 90% power with two-sided α=0.05. Limitations include: population restricted to low socioeconomic Hispanic individuals limiting generalizability; dietary choices and physical activity not assessed; medication changes during trial may have influenced HbA1c results.

trial_design: randomized, parallel-control study with three arms (Treatment Group 1, Treatment Group 2, Control Group), 1:1:1 allocation, no blinding reported
funding_source: Key Projects in the National Science and Technology Pillar Program in the Eleventh 5-Year Plan Periods (Grant 2007 BAI 18 B 02) and the Science and Technology Planning Project of Guangdong Province, China (Grant 2010B031600117)
notes: No conflicts of interest declared. Sample size calculation: ~53 patients per group for 80% power at two-sided significance level 0.05, based on expected mean change of -0.50%, -0.30%, and 0.10% in HbA1c for treatment groups 1, 2, and control, respectively. Study was underpowered (only 42-43 per group analyzed). Missing values imputed using last observation carried forward method.

trial_design: single-blinded randomized controlled trial with two parallel arms
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size: 14 subjects per arm (90% power, minimum 1% HbA1c difference, SD 0.8); 17 recruited per arm to account for dropout. Competing interests: none declared. Limitations: inflammatory markers not measured; long-term effects not determined. Trial retrospectively registered (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02745015, registered July 17, 2016).

trial_design: single center double-blind with two parallel-groups, randomized controlled trial with a follow-up of 6 months
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size calculation: alpha=0.05, beta=0.02, power=80%, minimum 68 participants per group to detect HbA1c difference of 0.5% (5 mmol/mol), with 20% dropout allowance. Conflicts of interest: none declared. Limitations: short follow-up period; multiple factors contribute to HbA1c fluctuations; both groups showed similar HbA1c changes over 6 months.

trial_design: Two-arm parallel randomized clinical trial, not double-blinded
funding_source: University of Malaya Research grants P0027/2009B and RG344/11
notes: No conflicts of interest declared. Sample size calculation: 15 subjects per arm needed for 80% power to detect 1% (11 mmol/mol) HbA1c difference; 20 per arm recruited to account for drop-outs. Limitations: not double-blinded; small sample size; unable to have a no-intervention control group due to ethical restrictions; moderating role of chlorhexidine mouthwash not fully controlled.

setting: VA medical centers (Department of Veterans Affairs facilities)
trial_design: multi-site, single-blind, randomized, controlled clinical trial with a two-by-two factorial design, two arms (Early Treatment and Usual Care)
funding_source: Department of Veterans Affairs Health Services Research & Development Service, Career Development Program, VA HSR&D QUERI DII 99.206, NIH K24 DE00419, and Boston University
notes: Sample size: study designed for 300 participants; 193 recruited, 165 in study after exclusions, 132 completed. A priori power: 80% power to detect effect size of 0.40 with 200 patients (100/group). Limitations: few women (VA population), potential undetected confounders, underpowered. Disclaimer: views do not represent the Department of Veterans Affairs. Industry support: Dentsply International provided ultrasonic scalers; Colgate Oral Pharmaceuticals provided chlorhexidine gluconate (PerioGard).

trial_design: parallel-group, randomized, open-label trial with two arms (intervention and control)
funding_source: National Health and Medical Research Council: Project grant #627100; National Heart Foundation of Australia #100419; University of Adelaide Divisional Scholarship
notes: Post hoc power calculation: 19% power with n=62; 398 participants required for sufficient power. Subgroup/secondary analysis of the PerioCardio RCT (not originally powered for glycaemic endpoint). Single-session non-surgical periodontal therapy provided. No conflict of interest declared.

trial_design: Three-arm parallel group RCT with partial blinding (examiner and laboratory personnel masked)
funding_source: Higher Education Commission of Pakistan through their National Research Program for Universities (NRPU) Grants [Grant No: 7143]
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sample size: minimum n=105 (35/group), increased to 150 (50/group) with 40% attrition allowance. Data not publicly available (part of PhD research). Large attrition at follow-up; reasons not systematically recorded. COVID-19 lockdown caused some missed final visits.

trial_design: Two-arm parallel randomized study: group A received non-surgical periodontal treatment (scaling and root planning) plus doxycycline; group B received doxycycline only without periodontal treatment (control)
funding_source: Organon (drug supplied as gift)
notes: Tibolone article (Kamenov et al.): drug (tibolone/Livial) was gifted by Organon; authors declare no relevant financial relationships. Study was a six-month prospective non-randomized case-control design. Multiple other articles in this issue contain no funding or conflict-of-interest statements.

setting: hospital, primary care (medical and dental practices)
trial_design: 12 month, single-centre, parallel-group, investigator-masked, randomised trial with two arms (IPT and CPT)
funding_source: Diabetes UK and UK National Institute for Health Research
notes: Sample size: minimum 129 participants per group to detect HbA1c difference of 1 percentage point (SD 2.1) at 12 months, alpha=0.05, 95% power, assuming 10% loss to follow-up. Conflicts of interest: none declared. Funder had role in study design but not in data collection, analysis, interpretation, or writing.

trial_design: Two-arm parallel randomized controlled trial; treatment group received full-mouth scaling and root planing, control group received no periodontal treatment; examining investigator was blinded to group assignments
funding_source: NR
notes: No conflict of interest, sample-size calculation, or data limitations statements found. Study approved by Ethical Committee of Ankara University, Faculty of Dentistry. Joint collaboration between Department of Metabolic Diseases and Endocrinology and Department of Periodontology, Ankara University.

trial_design: Two-arm parallel randomized controlled trial; Treatment group (n=11) received OHI plus scaling and root debridement; Control group (n=7) received OHI alone; examiners were blinded to group assignments
funding_source: Hong Kong Research Grants Council (GRF No. HKU 768411M and 17155216) and Modern Dental Laboratory/HKU Endowment Fund
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sample size calculated using G*Power 3.0 with 80% power at significance level 0.05. Limitations include small sample size, PCR array performed on only 4 of 11 Treatment group patients, and blood samples collected only at baseline and 6 months.

trial_design: prospective, open-labelled, randomized controlled clinical trial; two-centre; two parallel groups; 1:1 allocation; 3-month follow-up
funding_source: French Ministry of Health Clinical Research Hospital Program; ACTEON® Group; Oral-B France
notes: No conflicts of interest declared. Sample size calculated to detect 0.5% change in HbA1c, requiring 64 participants per group (80% power, two-sided test, 5% significance, SD=1.0%). Trial stopped early due to futility (conditional power below 35%).

trial_design: 6-month, single-masked, single center, randomized clinical trial with two parallel arms (control and periodontal treatment group)
funding_source: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare: 25110601
notes: Sample size: 17 subjects per group needed for 80% power, alpha 0.05; conflict of interest: none declared; data availability restricted due to ethical/legal reasons.

trial_design: 3-arm parallel randomized controlled clinical trial; Group A (scaling and root planing only), Group B (scaling and root planing + systemic doxycycline), Group C (no treatment control); blinding NR
funding_source: none declared
notes: Conflict of interest: None declared. No sample-size calculation details reported. No data limitations explicitly stated.

setting: outpatient medical and dental clinics, university/academic medical centers, community
trial_design: 6-month, single-masked, multicenter, randomized clinical trial with 2 parallel arms (treatment and control)
funding_source: National Institute of Dental and Craniofacial Research, National Institutes of Health
notes: Sample size: 468 participants required for 90% power to detect 0.6% HbA1c reduction; planned n=600 with 20% attrition; enrollment stopped early at n=514 due to futility. Conflicts of interest: Dr Gelato received travel expenses from Endocrine Society; Dr Sequist served as consultant for multiple pharma companies and received grants from ADA/Eli Lilly/NIH; Dr Lewis received grant from Novo Nordisk; Dr Katanick served as consultant and received grants from Zimmer Dental; Dr Paquette served as board member and consultant for Colgate-Palmolive and MIS Implant Technologies. Limitations: no systemic antibiotics used; no surgical treatment; HbA1c range restricted to 7%-<9%; results may not apply outside this range.

trial_design: 3-arm, parallel, prospective randomized clinical trial; subjects not blinded
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size: at least 15 patients per group estimated for 90% power (p<0.05); Conflict of interest: None; Limitation: small sample size, no nondiabetic comparator group, block randomization may introduce selection bias.
